title: Shared definitions: identifiers, clocks, citations, closed enumerations
description: Every object schema references these. Identifier prefixes are the stable ids of ARQUITECTURA.md section 3. Field names are English (the code language); domain enumeration values are Portuguese (the API language). See DECISIONS.md D1.

id_passagem.description: Norm short code, colon, structural path: ccp:art113.2, ccp:art20.1.a

id_vigencia.description: Passage id, @, the date the version enters force: ccp:art20.1@2026-10-01

id_regra.description: regra:<norm>:<slug>@v<n>; the @v suffix is the rule's own version, distinct from the store revision

id_entidade.description: ent:nif:<9 digits> when the NIF is known; ent:cand:<ISO country>:<name slug> otherwise. Never merged: a candidate that turns out to have a NIF gets a settled link, not a rename.

id_principal.description: Product rule 2026-10-24 (DECISIONS D22): the prefix is the role. pessoa (humano), leitor / extrator / redator (automatizado, with familia A or B and a motor), ferramenta (codigo, versioned: ferramenta:verify@1).

envelope.description: Record envelope of every stored object. The store is append-only: a change is a new revision of the same id; (id, revision) is never written twice; stale marks a record superseded or withdrawn, nothing is deleted (invariant 9).

recorded_at.description: Record clock: when this revision entered the store.

supersedes.description: The revision this one replaces, when revision > 1.

citation.description: Invariant 2: a passage id, the literal quote and its offsets inside that passage version's text. verify re-reads text[start:end] and refuses a mismatch. The AI chooses the passage id; the code writes the quote.

version.description: The passage version quoted: its valid_from date.

raw_citation.description: A literal quote located inside a captured raw text (used for DR validity notes, before passages exist).

jurisdiction.description: Portugal continental, Açores, Madeira, European Union.

reason_not_assessed.description: Closed enumeration (invariant 6). facto_ausente: a fact the rule needs is missing; regra_ausente: no settled rule covers the case; cobertura_insuficiente: an aggregate rule's source coverage is below the completeness threshold; documento_sem_texto: a required document has no text layer; conflito: an unresolved conflict on a fact the rule needs.

rule_type.description: The rule types of ARQUITECTURA.md section 5, prazo_maximo (D71) and contagem_prazo (D83).

assertion_state.description: Derived by replaying the governance log; stored copies are the replay, never the source.

model_family.description: Invariant 5: a reading settles only when upheld blind by a leitor of the other family. Families are named A and B in the log; which engine is which is a field of the principal (motor), never part of an id or a published output.

condition.description: A predicate over a canonical fact field, as data. The engine evaluates it; nothing is interpreted at run time.

canonical_field.description: Canonical fact field names (snake_case): tipo_contrato, preco_base, prazo_propostas_dias, data_inicio_procedimento, data_publicacao_anuncio, tipo_procedimento, tipo_entidade, territorio, publicado_joue, cpv, ...
